cases.prompt: Garde cette chaîne en modèle réutilisable nommé tampons_routes, à côté du projet enregistré : un buffer de 500 m sur les routes, puis les centroïdes du résultat.

call_args.purpose: Enregistrer tampons_routes.model3 à côté du projet, sans écraser ni exécuter les traitements.
call_args.code:
from pathlib import Path
from qgis.core import (QgsProject, QgsProcessingModelAlgorithm, QgsProcessingModelParameter,
    QgsProcessingParameterFeatureSource, QgsProcessingParameterNumber, QgsProcessingModelChildAlgorithm,
    QgsProcessingModelChildParameterSource, QgsProcessingModelOutput)
project_file = QgsProject.instance().fileName()
if not project_file:
    raise ValueError("Save the project or choose a model path first")
model_path = Path(project_file).resolve().parent / "tampons_routes.model3"
if model_path.exists():
    raise FileExistsError(str(model_path))
model = QgsProcessingModelAlgorithm()
model.setName("tampons_routes")
model.setGroup("FilterMate")
definitions = [QgsProcessingParameterFeatureSource("INPUT", "Routes"),
    QgsProcessingParameterNumber("DISTANCE", "Distance", defaultValue=500)]
for definition in definitions:
    component = QgsProcessingModelParameter()
    component.setParameterName(definition.name())
    model.addModelParameter(definition, component)
source = QgsProcessingModelChildParameterSource
buffer = QgsProcessingModelChildAlgorithm("native:buffer")
buffer.setChildId("buffer")
for parameter, values in {
    "INPUT": [source.fromModelParameter("INPUT")],
    "DISTANCE": [source.fromModelParameter("DISTANCE")],
    "SEGMENTS": [source.fromStaticValue(5)], "END_CAP_STYLE": [source.fromStaticValue(0)],
    "JOIN_STYLE": [source.fromStaticValue(0)], "MITER_LIMIT": [source.fromStaticValue(2)],
    "DISSOLVE": [source.fromStaticValue(False)], "OUTPUT": [source.fromStaticValue("TEMPORARY_OUTPUT")],
}.items():
    buffer.addParameterSources(parameter, values)
model.addChildAlgorithm(buffer)
final = QgsProcessingModelChildAlgorithm("native:centroids")
final.setChildId("final")
final.addParameterSources("INPUT", [source.fromChildOutput("buffer", "OUTPUT")])
final.addParameterSources("ALL_PARTS", [source.fromStaticValue(False)])
output = QgsProcessingModelOutput()
output.setName("RESULT")
output.setDescription("Final result")
output.setChildId("final")
output.setChildOutputName("OUTPUT")
final.setModelOutputs({"RESULT": output})
model.addChildAlgorithm(final)
model.updateDestinationParameters()
valid, issues = model.validate()
if not valid:
    raise ValueError(str(issues))
if model_path.exists():
    raise FileExistsError(str(model_path))
if not model.toFile(str(model_path)):
    raise RuntimeError("Model could not be saved")
restored = QgsProcessingModelAlgorithm()
if not restored.fromFile(str(model_path)):
    raise RuntimeError("Saved model could not be read")
valid, issues = restored.validate()
if not valid:
    raise ValueError(str(issues))
result = {"path": str(model_path), "inputs": [p.name() for p in restored.parameterDefinitions()],
    "outputs": [p.name() for p in restored.destinationParameterDefinitions()],
    "steps": ["buffer", "final"]}
